name: @sparx/mcp-storefront
description: sparx Storefront MCP server (docs/113) — the shopper-facing MCP plane. A thin, stateless MCP over the public /v1/public/* REST API: shoppers point their own LLM at a store to browse, check availability, book, and check out. No DB, no module packages — every tool is an HTTP adapter over the public API (@sparx/storefront-mcp).
